claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item UnitRecord kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no MagicItemRecord variant and no magic_item family in types.ts. The v4 taxonomy has magic_item_root but the TS surface has never been widened to expose it. No honest encoding is possible without adding this kind.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement) — the unit is fundamentally a magic item, not a spell, class feature, or mastery.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_bundle family (multi-effect always-on attunement)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak grants four simultaneous passive benefits while worn and attuned. No existing spell/class-feature/mastery family models a bundle of heterogeneous always-on passive effects. The closest spell families (ongoing_effect, triggered_reaction) are single-operation and require a casting procedure; there is no 'attunement_passive' or 'passive_bundle' mechanics family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing it, you gain the following benefits. [four sub-bullets follow, each a distinct always-on effect]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: dawn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Web property resets at the next dawn, not at a short or long rest. The current RestResetCadence union has short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, partial_short_full_long — none of which map to dawn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: charge resource in types.ts
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Web casting property uses a per-dawn charge. The v4 taxonomy has a 'charge' resource atom, but types.ts only exposes use_count and spell_slot. A charge with dawn reset is mechanically distinct from use_count with rest reset.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_climb_speed (or modify_speed variant with speed-kind discriminant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spider Climb grants a Climb Speed equal to the wearer's Speed. The v4 taxonomy has modify_speed but types.ts has no ClassFeatureEffect or magic-item effect variant for granting a typed movement speed. A 'climb' speed kind needs to be distinguished from fly/swim/hover.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: web_immunity / traverse_difficult_terrain_as_normal (movement filter immunity)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spider Walk grants immunity to being restrained by webs and allows moving through web difficult terrain freely. No v4 atom covers 'immunity to a specific terrain/restraint type'. block_travel (v4) models blocking movement but not its negation. This is a new narrow effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.
